Following the ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 and $120 off AirPods Max 2 last week, today's midday news from 9to5Toys is led by Amazon once again lowering the price of AirTag 2 to a new low, with the 4-pack now selling for $80 ($20 each). Also on offer: the Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro down $320, and the 2TB M5 Pro down $500; also worth noting is Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card hitting an all-time low of $25 on Amazon, plus the LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor, which is a full $2,200 cheaper than the Apple Studio Display XDR (its all-time low). See details below.

The latest AirPods Pro 3 maintains a 25% discount; the next generation isn't expected until 2027.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

Hello everyone! The AirTag 2 price has been lowered again, with the 4-pack now at $80, a new low ($20 each)

Alright, let's get started, friends: Amazon is now offering the all-time lowest price on the Apple 2026 AirTag 2 4-pack—only $20 each.

Amazon has now dropped the AirTag 2 4-pack to $79.99 with free shipping.

We've been tracking this official pack at $89.99 all last week, until Amazon cut the price again yesterday to $85, and earlier this week even lower to a new low. Originally priced at $99, the discount is close to 20%, which is quite a rare deal for the latest AirTag 2.

This pack works out to just $20 per AirTag, the lowest price since its launch earlier this year.

The single AirTag 2 remains at last week's low of $24 with free shipping for Prime members, while the 4-pack has again been discounted further.

This $20-each price matches the best open-box deal seen at Best Buy last week, for the record.

Apple 24GB/1TB M5 MacBook Pro now $320 off, 2TB M5 Pro $500 off

In addition to the ongoing 25% discount on AirPods Pro 3 and the AirTag 2 hitting the lowest price we've tracked, there are also several notable deals on the latest MacBook Pro lineup this week. Amazon still has the 2TB M5 Pro down $500, and we just spotted a chance to grab this more affordable M5 MacBook Pro 24GB configuration with $300 off. Details below.

If you want the more powerful M5 Pro, this $500-off model on Amazon is definitely worth a look. But if you'd prefer the more affordable M5, B&H has a solid deal on the 14-inch 24GB/1TB configuration:

B&H has again knocked the Apple 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro (with 24GB RAM and 1TB internal storage) down to $1,899 with free shipping.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (original price $2,219)
  • Includes the upgraded 96W Apple charger

This machine is originally priced at $2,199, and B&H additionally throws in the official 96W Apple charger—which would cost an extra $20 if you configured it on Apple's website.

Amazon has the same MacBook Pro configuration for $2,049, including the standard 70W charger.

Overall, B&H's deal saves you $320, similar to the previously mentioned discount, and is a better value than Amazon's current pricing.

As mentioned above, Amazon still has a very worthwhile price live: the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB down to $2,699—that's $500 off the original $3,199, and this deal probably won't last long.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card (supports iOS or Android) drops to an all-time Amazon low of $25

Anker recently launched a brand-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card, the first product to support both Apple's Find My platform and Google's Find Hub, and it's now down to an all-time Amazon low of $25 with free shipping for Prime members.

It launched on Amazon just last month at $35, then got a slight $5 discount at the end of the month, and now it's seeing its first significant price cut, hitting an all-time Amazon low.

The discount is close to 30%, on par with the best prices we've tracked on similar wallet tracker cards this year.

Personally, I'm a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards—from $35, with the Pro model at $45, offering up to 16 months of battery life before needing a recharge—but whichever you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or cardholder. It's a must-have for me when I head out.

The latest Anker-branded SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the important features, including wireless charging, and is compatible with Apple Find My or Google Find Hub. It's just 1.7mm thick, with a ringer volume of up to 80 decibels for locating the card nearby—and of course you can add it directly to the Find My and Find Hub apps to view its location on a map.

Tidy up your desk with Anker's clever clip-on power strip, now down to $58

LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits lowest price ever, a full $2,200 cheaper than the Studio Display XDR

We just spotted a deal at B&H that drops the LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K monitor to $1,099.99 with free shipping. This monitor originally launched at $2,000 and has sold for as much as $1,597 in recent months. Today's deal matches the all-time low that appeared on Amazon earlier this month and is still valid. LG's official site is also matching at $1,100 today, so if a retailer runs out of stock there are still other options. At this price, the UltraFine evo 6K is significantly cheaper than Apple's monitor. The Studio Display XDR starts at $3,299, meaning LG's 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor is a full $2,200 cheaper. Even the standard Studio Display starts at $1,549, so you're saving around $500 while getting a larger 32-inch 6K display. See details below.

The LG 32-inch UltraFine evo 6K is a high-end workstation monitor designed for creators who want a large, sharp display without upgrading to Apple's pricier options. Its 6144 x 3456 panel offers over 21 million pixels at 224 PPI, giving you plenty of space for editing timelines, full-resolution content, tools, and multiple windows. It covers 99.5% of the Adobe RGB color gamut and supports VESA DisplayHDR 600 for better highlights and contrast. Connectivity is also comprehensive, including Thunderbolt 5, DisplayPort 2.1, HDMI, and USB-C. Mac users can also take advantage of LG's Studio Mode with calibrated color presets to maintain color consistency for creative work. Overall, it's a feature-rich 6K option for those who want true large-screen real estate without paying Apple's monitor prices.

Woot also has some solid deals on affordable Samsung workstation monitors if you don't want to spend over $1,000 on a new display. The brand's lineup of M series and other budget-friendly models are on sale, starting from just $118.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker card is compatible with both iPhone and Android, now down to $20 (all-time low)
  • This compact UGREEN ultra-thin 45W Nexode Air charger is the slimmest one in my EDC, now just $27
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter down to $40 on Amazon (black or white)
  • Chipolo Google Find Hub wallet card with super button/remote shutter now down to $33
  • UGREEN MagFlow 25W Qi2.2 car charger back to $28 (original price $40)
  • Acer metal MagSafe high-golf car mount flash sale down to $20 with free shipping for Prime members

The latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits an all-time low on Amazon with close to 30% off (wired version also on special)

In addition to a range of late-summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also offering the all-time lowest price on its latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro, and has brought the wired version back to its Prime Day all-time low—both models close to 30% off the original price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (original price $250)

Although the brand later launched the more affordable Ring Peephole Cam 2K for $100, today we're focusing on several particularly notable deals on the latest Pro-tier 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is now back at the all-time low from Prime Day at the end of June, hitting that price for the first time since that 4-day sales event. In fact, this is only the second time we've tracked this model below $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro is now seeing its first discount, also setting an all-time low of $180.

As noted above, both models are priced at $250, currently discounted by close to 30%, the best deals available now and the lowest prices on record.

The two models have largely the same features, both offering up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K recording for a clearer view of your doorstep; the wireless version comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easy charging and simpler installation (no wiring required); the wired version offers "endless power, around-the-clock protection."

For details, check out our September last year product launch coverage.

Best Buy launches brand-new tech product deals, NFL Sunday Ticket promotion, and preseason TV offers

Amazon now takes $120 off all five colors of AirPods Max 2 (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary promotion brings one of the best prices yet for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now taking $120 off all five colors.

Amazon has now cut Apple AirPods Max 2 to $429 with free shipping.

Compared to the $549 pricing of the previous generation, you save $120 here, the best available right now for brand-new units from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black model at $403.99 with free shipping in "excellent" open-box condition, slightly cheaper, but the difference may not be worth giving up a brand-new unit.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new color and USB-C. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear headphones won't be refreshed in next month's new product announcement, so this week's $120 discount may be the newest and strongest combination for these Apple over-ear headphones in some time.

Only one previous sales event offered a lower price—Prime Day this summer, which was $30 cheaper than today's deal, but stock was quite tight and inconsistent during the 4-day event.

Amazon has this 512GB iPad mini on sale for $450 off new pricing (Renewed Premium condition)

Although iPad Air deals have just started appearing this week, iPad discounts in general have been weak recently, even nonexistent. That said, we just spotted Amazon selling a 512GB iPad mini in top-tier Renewed Premium condition for a massive $450 off the new price.

Amazon has now dropped the 512GB iPad mini A17 (latest model) to $449 with free shipping.

This would normally cost $899 as a brand-new Apple unit, but you can get it on Amazon now, saving $450.

Worth noting that even before the price increase, we've never seen this model drop below $679 in new condition on Amazon.

Just a reminder, Amazon Renewed Premium is different from regular Renewed and even "excellent" condition refurbished units; the packaging is as follows:

  • Screen: No scratches, if any.
  • Body: No visible cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, etc.) when viewed from 12 inches away.
  • Battery: If applicable, battery capacity exceeds 90% of original life.
  • Accessories: Comes with original or third-party accessories and packaging.
  • Warranty: Renewed Premium products come with a 365-day return period.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro now $220 off (matches Prime Day deal)

Although the official Apple Certified Refurbished store is my top recommendation for buying an iPhone, Apple hasn't started selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet—it seems we'll have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed listings are now back at Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off compared to new pricing.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed units remain the best option for grabbing an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Besides saving a few hundred dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "greater than 90% original battery life"—regular non-"Premium" Renewed and refurbished listings only offer a 90-day warranty and different battery life standards.

Now, 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back to up to $220 off—the 512GB is another $20 cheaper than the previously mentioned price:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new original price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (new original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (new original price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (new original price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can grab a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model starting from $699 with a 1-year Apple warranty; the 1TB 16 Pro Max is $1,269—that's $330 cheaper than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 starting from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)
